application_profile_summary: Static prerendered personal/professional site operated by Yippify (S3 + Cloudflare). Contact form collects name, email, company, topic and message (Lambda + SES us-west-2, emailed only; salted-hash IP for rate limiting; logs 30 days). Analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics (cookieless), GA4 removed 2026-10-12; anonymous CTA click counts on /engineering-leadership/ via a Cloudflare Worker + Analytics Engine (event, page, link only; 3-month retention), added 2026-10-22. Privacy notice at /privacy/. Owner in California; global visitors; B2B adults; no sale/sharing; no AI processing.

items.name: California Online Privacy Protection Act (B&P §22575-22579)
items.applicability_basis: Commercial site collecting PII from CA consumers via contact form
items.summary: Conspicuously post privacy policy: categories of PII and third parties, change process, effective date, DNT response, third-party tracking disclosure.

items.name: CCPA/CPRA
items.applicability_basis: Revenue far below $26,625,000; no selling/sharing; low consumer volume
items.summary: Revenue threshold $26,625,000 from 2025-01-01; next CPI adjustment 2027-01-01.

items.name: ePrivacy Directive Art. 5(3)
items.applicability_basis: Only if non-essential storage/access on EU visitors' devices; none after GA4 removal
items.summary: Prior consent for non-essential storage/access on terminal equipment.

items.name: GDPR
items.summary: Transparency (Art. 13), lawful basis, data subject rights, transfers.

items.name: Digital Omnibus (GDPR Art. 88a cookie proposal)
items.applicability_basis: Would change cookie consent rules if adopted
items.summary: Secondary sources: Sept 2026 Council text drops Art. 88a, returning to ePrivacy 5(3); no Council mandate yet. Secondary source only.

items.name: EU-US DPF challenge, Latombe v Commission (C-703/25 P)
items.applicability_basis: EU visitor data processed by AWS/Cloudflare in the US
items.summary: General Court upheld DPF 2025-09-03; appeal pending at CJEU.

items.name: PECR reg. 6 as amended by Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 s.112
items.applicability_basis: Only if storage/access technologies are used on UK visitors; none after GA4 removal
items.summary: New exemptions incl. statistical purposes with clear info and free opt-out; ICO notes third-party analytics may not qualify; PECR fines up to £17.5m/4%.

items.name: PIPEDA
items.applicability_basis: US operator; Canadian visitors' data in commercial activity
items.summary: Consent and openness principles; privacy notice satisfies openness.

items.name: Bill C-36, Protecting Privacy and Consumer Data Act
European Accessibility Act (Directive 2019/882)
items.applicability_basis: Microenterprise services exemption; portfolio site not an in-scope service
items.summary: Accessibility for listed products/services; microenterprises providing services exempt.
